notes.title: v1.1.2 (LOTS of changes)
notes.notes:
LOTS of changes and fixes with this one, including the overhaul to try and balance the Drachma system better.

Major Changes

Drachmas are now earned on a multiplying scale after all upgrades have been unlocked.
The 16 new stickers now actually have their unlock status save. (Can't BELIEVE I didn't catch that one earlier. ːsteamfacepalmː)
Reset achievement values have been reduced from 1-10-25 to 1-5-10.
Tooltip describing how Drachmas work appears when hovering over the reset button or large Drachma icons in the UI.


Minor Changes

Car and truck now have visible seats.
Dolly cart and car wheels are more centered.
The sun reflection now stays on the water layer in Asphodel theme.
The click counter will now first appear after 100 total clicks.

notes.title: Sticker Update! v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Finished this major update far sooner than expected! Decided to push it as soon as possible before I devote my weekend to playing Silksong lol.


Major Changes

16 new stickers!
Stickers now have rotation and scaling options!
Added an "undo" button next to the "delete all" button in the sticker UI.
The first 4 stickers are now free in the reset sticker unlocks menu.


Minor Changes

The "undo" button in the sticker menu is now the only one with the dotted arrow icon. All closing menu buttons now say "back" or "return" to avoid confusion.
Further tweaking of values for the ground reset threshold.

notes.title: Update Roadmap / Future Plans
notes.notes:
Alrighty! Time to crack down on fixes and polishing for the next several weeks (potentially months).



First and foremost, I will be working on balancing and bug fixes. Bug fixes will be prioritized, though I don't believe there will be as many bugs as balance fixes. Currently, I am trying to pace out the Drachma earning, purchases and reset system so that it just feels more satisfying, especially in the late game.





Listed below is the rough roadmap for planned updates:


 - *PATCHES/HOTFIXES/BALANCING* (Continuous throughout project)

 - STICKER UPDATE
	- Sticker rotation and sizing

	- Sticker selection and individual deleting

	- 16 New stickers


 - BOULDER + THEME UPDATE
	- 6 New Boulders

	- 3 New Themes

	- 6 New Theme Colors

	- Dust sliding effect

	- Path rubble/clutter that actually clears


 - LOCALIZATION UPDATE
	- Spanish

	- Russian

	- German

	- Chinese (Simplified)

	- Japanese


 - SOUND UPDATE
	- Vehicle sounds

	- Updated/Improved sounds

	- Music and autosave labels fade away


 - (Potentially (Hopefully!)) LINUX AND STEAM DECK SUPPORT

 - GOG RELEASE

 - MOBILE PORT




The order will likely be as listed, though it is very possible that any of these updates could be finished earlier or later than expected.



If anyone is able to provide localization support (especially for any languages not listed), please reach out to me at sickbastardgames@gmail.com!



Thanks again to everyone who purchased the game and bigger thanks for everyone's patience as I continue to improve it. Fingers crossed, I should be able to finish this and start my next project before the end of the year.
-GC
